The selected CartoCiudad portal result is the exact street number and carries cadastral reference 1156716VK7815S.
Catastro Consulta_DNPRC for 1156716VK7815S returns AV PUNTO COM 23, urban industrial use, a 78,394 m2 parcel, 43,474 m2 built and construction year 2012 (ADC1 opened in 2013 per the operator).

The Alcalá de Henares infrastructure special plan (initial-approval version, January 2023; Internet Archive copy) places the planned ST Cisneros substation on a 3,726.30 m2 subparcel of that same 78,394 m2 parcel (plan parcel 6-7) and says it is needed for NABIAX's power request for its new hosting centre in Alcalá. Parcel 6-7 has 61,533 m2 maximum buildability, of which 31,201.43 m2 was consumed.

The city record of September 18, 2026 describes ADC3 as the construction of a third building within the Campus Externo, taking the complex past 100 MW IT. The operator campus page says the campus has its first two phases built and 100 MW expansion potential.
